answer: Charge identity number k inside any cohort a fee of k squared microcredits, so the first few signups feel like a faint pigment wash while a thousand-clone plume costs on the order of N cubed over three. A broke prankster at the nadir of funding can still afford one honest handle, but a 5,000-sybil farm faces millions of units that burn on payment and cannot be pooled or resold across shells. Honest latecomers enter through sponsored first-seat vouchers from established peers, keeping the door open without reopening the floodgate.
